rationale: B wins, slightly, because it keeps the strongest story cleaner: "Glossier spent a decade as DTC-only. Wholesale is now its fastest-growing channel" says exactly what the facts support, while A's "quietly became a wholesale company" gets a little high on its own contrarian fumes. B also has the better proof discipline in the line "Three unnamed products with no prices, dates, or category context is an announcement, not a story." A is strong material, but its DTC and fragrance angles ask the founder to carry more proof than the update currently gives.
gaps_in_A: "quietly became a wholesale company" overstates the fact pattern. Fastest-growing channel does not mean wholesale is now the company's core business.
"the collapse of the direct-to-consumer thesis" is too sweeping without market comps. A notices the proof gap, but the framing still leans bigger than the supplied facts.

"A brand born from a beauty blog is now betting on the perfume aisle" is viable only after product names, positioning, and fragrance category context exist. Right now it is a dressed-up product-launch angle.
A treats "Sephora at Kohl's" mostly as a door-count detail and misses the sharper brand-positioning question: what happens when a cult DTC beauty brand enters a more mass retail environment?
gaps_in_B: "Twelve years from beauty blog to 1,400 retail doors" is the softest angle. Without founder or CEO access and real inflection points, it becomes a tidy retrospective looking for a magazine editor to do charity work.
"The beauty brand born on a blog is coming to Kohl's" compresses "Sephora at Kohl's" into Kohl's. That headline can mislead if the Kohl's portion of the 800 added doors is small.
"wholesale-led growth phase" overreaches. Fastest-growing channel is not the same as leading channel, especially when the company discloses no revenue or profitability.

The refusal of "Glossier launches three new fragrance products" is disciplined but a little too final. "First fragrance line extension" could be a real beauty-trade angle once product details are supplied.
